description: Synchronous switching-state modulation for high fundamental frequencies. Above the mode-switch frequency it emits direct switching states (as 0/100 duties) synchronized to the demanded voltage vector; below it, Active is false so the graph can route async SVPWM duties instead.

inputPorts.name: V_Alpha
inputPorts.description: Demanded voltage vector, alpha component (from inverse Park).

inputPorts.name: V_Beta
inputPorts.description: Demanded voltage vector, beta component (from inverse Park).

inputPorts.name: V_Dc
inputPorts.description: DC-link voltage used to normalize the demanded magnitude.

inputPorts.name: Omega_Mech
inputPorts.description: Mechanical motor speed in revolutions per minute.

inputPorts.name: Poles
inputPorts.description: Motor pole count used to convert mechanical speed to electrical frequency.

outputPorts.name: Active
outputPorts.description: True while synchronous mode is engaged (fundamental at or above the switch frequency).

outputPorts.name: F_Elec
outputPorts.description: Estimated electrical fundamental frequency in hertz.

outputPorts.name: N_Pulses
outputPorts.description: Effective pulses per half cycle of the current pattern (1 = six-step).

FmSwitchHz.description: Electrical frequency at which synchronous mode takes over from SVPWM.

FAsyncHz.description: Async carrier frequency used to cap the chopping rate when selecting pulse count.

Poles.description: Fallback motor pole count when the Poles input is not wired.

DwellAcc.description: Persistent zero-vector dwell accumulator state (leave at default).
